See also: trocó, trôco, and troço

English

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

troco (uncountable)

  1. Alternative form of trucco (“lawn billiards”).

Anagrams

[edit]
  • coort

Galician

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈtɾɔko/ [ˈt̪ɾɔ.kʊ]
  • Rhymes: -ɔko
  • Hyphenation: tro‧co

Etymology 1

[edit]

Back-formation from trocar.

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • troque

Noun

[edit]

troco m (plural trocos)

  1. barter; exchange, switch
    Synonyms: cambio, intercambio
Related terms
[edit]
  • en troques
  • en troques de
  • trocar

Etymology 2

[edit]

Verb

[edit]

troco

  1. first-person singular present indicative of trocar

Latin

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Unknown. Probably borrowed from Frankish *trokōn.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Classical Latin) IPA(key): [ˈtrɔ.koː]
  • (modern Italianate Ecclesiastical) IPA(key): [ˈtrɔː.ko]

Verb

[edit]

trocō (present infinitive trocāre, perfect active trocāvī, supine trocātum); first conjugation

  1. (Medieval Latin) to barter

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology 1

[edit]

    Deverbal from trocar (“to switch; to exchange”), from Medieval Latin trocāre (“to barter”).

    Alternative forms

    [edit]
    • trôco (pre-reform spelling)

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
     
    • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈtɾo.ku/
    • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈtɾo.ku/
      • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈtɾo.ko/
    • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ˈtɾo.ku/

    • Rhymes: -oku
    • Hyphenation: tro‧co

    Noun

    [edit]

    troco m (plural trocos, metaphonic)

    1. change (small denominations of money given in exchange for a larger denomination)
      Synonym: trocado
    2. (rare) exchange; switch (act of exchanging or switching two thing)
      Synonyms: permutação, substituição, troca
    3. (in the plural) a small amount of money
      Synonyms: trocado, miúdo
    4. (informal) payback (act of revenge)
      Synonyms: retorno, vingança
    Derived terms
    [edit]
    • a troco de
    • dar o troco
    • dar troco a
    • receber o troco
    Related terms
    [edit]
    • troca
    • trocadilho
    • trocado
    • trocador
    • trocar

    • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ˈtɾɔ.ku/

    Verb

    troco

    1. first-person singular present indicative of trocar
